mapper.sql: mr.room_id, mr.room_name, mr.room_number, mr.building, mr.capacity, mr.area, mr.description, mr.photo_url, mr.qr_code_url, mr.is_available, mr.created_at, mr.updated_at, u.user_id AS creator_id, u.user_name AS creator_name
mapper.select: SELECT FROM meeting_room mr LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.user_id = mr.created_by ORDER BY mr.room_id
SELECT FROM meeting_room mr LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.user_id = mr.created_by WHERE mr.is_available = 1 ORDER BY mr.room_id
SELECT FROM meeting_room mr LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.user_id = mr.created_by WHERE mr.room_id = #{roomId}
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM meeting_room WHERE room_number = #{roomNumber}
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM meeting_room WHERE room_number = #{roomNumber} AND room_id != #{roomId}
SELECT FROM meeting_room mr LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.user_id = mr.created_by WHERE mr.building = #{building} AND mr.capacity >= #{capacity} AND mr.is_available = 1 ORDER BY mr.capacity, mr.room_id
SELECT FROM meeting_room mr LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.user_id = mr.created_by WHERE mr.capacity >= #{capacity} AND mr.is_available = 1 ORDER BY mr.capacity, mr.room_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO meeting_room (room_name, room_number, building, capacity, area, description, photo_url, qr_code_url, is_available, created_by) VALUES (#{roomName}, #{roomNumber}, #{building}, #{capacity}, #{area}, #{description}, #{photoUrl}, #{qrCodeUrl}, #{isAvailable}, #{createdBy.userId})
mapper.update: UPDATE meeting_room SET room_name = #{roomName}, room_number = #{roomNumber}, building = #{building}, capacity = #{capacity}, area = #{area}, description = #{description}, photo_url = #{photoUrl}, qr_code_url = #{qrCodeUrl}, is_available = #{isAvailable}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE room_id = #{roomId}
